The same venue runs inclusive additional-needs sessions with the music off and lower lighting, so it's worth asking about a quieter slot when you book. Dates are limited.

events.description: Touring big-top stunt circus show. Sat 24 & Sun 25 Oct performances cancelled due to Storm Boelo (tickets exchangeable). Remaining shows: 28 Oct 17:00/19:45; 29–30 Oct 15:00/19:00; 31 Oct 13:00/16:00; 1 Nov 14:00/17:00; 6 Nov 17:00/19:45; 7 Nov 14:00/17:00/19:45; 8 Nov 12:00/15:00. Can be loud.

events.name: Donaghadee Christmas Market & Santa Parade
events.description: Town Christmas market and Santa parade, with Santa arriving by lifeboat at 2pm.

events.name: Fangtastic Fun at 2 Royal Avenue
events.description: Belfast One Halloween weekend at 2 Royal Avenue: pumpkin decorating, monster mask craft workshop, spooky storytelling, face painting, walkabout characters and a Halloween disco. (The Ghost Trail on 31 Oct is adults only.)

events.name: Haunted Harvest Treat Trail, Ballymena
events.description: Free town-centre Halloween treat trail: collect a map at Tower Centre (start any time 12–2pm) and visit businesses for treats. Free face painting at Tower Centre 12–4pm, fancy-dress competition at Fairhill 2–4pm, plus council play buses (incl. sensory bus) on Wellington Street.

events.name: Banbridge Leisure Centre pools & water slide
events.description: Four pools including a leisure pool, toddler pool and 50m winding water slide (flume sessions every hour during public swims); Parents/Kids exclusive sessions in the minor pool. No advance booking needed for family swims. Under-5s swim free.

events.name: The Phantom Flyer: Halloween train, Downpatrick & County Down Railway
events.description: Interactive family Halloween show on a heritage diesel train to Inch Abbey and back, with Van Helsing, vampires, witches and zombies, plus face painting for kids. Designed with children in mind (parental discretion for very young/nervous children); the first train each day runs fully in daylight. Come in costume; parts are outdoors. Pre-booking strongly advised.
events.venue: Downpatrick & County Down Railway, Market Street
events.price: Family (2+2 or 1+3) £63; extra adult/child £18; under 4 free; carers free (+6% booking fee)

events.name: Lapland Express Santa train (all departures), Downpatrick & County Down Railway
events.description: Christmas train ride to Inch Abbey with Santa, Mrs Claus and the elves: interactive magic and games, Santa visits each child at their seat, festive drink and treat, and a plush-toy present for every child. About 45 minutes on board. Advance booking essential (no tickets on the day). A separate quiet train runs Sat 28 Nov 4:30pm.
events.venue: Downpatrick & County Down Railway, Market Street
events.price: Child £27 (incl. present), adult £22, infant 0–12m free (+6% booking fee)

events.name: Dundonald International Ice Bowl: ice skating, Indiana Land & bowling
events.description: NI's only public Olympic-size ice rink, plus Indiana Land jungle-themed indoor play (ages 11 and under, 1hr15 sessions; separate toddler area; Free Fall slide 6+), Xtreme tenpin bowling and Clip 'n Climb. Online pre-booking available. The current building is due to be replaced by a new facility in 2027.
events.venue: Dundonald International Ice Bowl, 111 Old Dundonald Road

events.name: North Down Museum, Bangor Castle
events.description: Free museum in the Bangor Castle stable block: dress up as a monk or a Viking in the replica longhouse, Little Historians dress-up gallery with activity sheets and story books, photo trails, and Explorer's Packs to borrow for Castle Park. Sensory packs available at reception. Café on site.
events.venue: North Down Museum, Town Hall, Castle Park

events.name: Carrickfergus Museum
events.description: Free town museum telling the story of Carrickfergus, with a play zone for under-5s and regular family events. No booking needed; fully accessible with baby changing. About an hour's visit.
events.venue: Carrickfergus Museum & Civic Centre, 11 Antrim Street

events.name: Irish Linen Centre & Lisburn Museum
events.description: Free museum on Market Square: linen, local history and art galleries, with the free Flaxie spot-the-picture trail for younger visitors (about 45 mins, collect at reception) and free family craft programmes in school holidays.
events.venue: Irish Linen Centre & Lisburn Museum, Market Square

events.name: A Magical Christmas Experience, Titanic Belfast
events.description: Hour-long guided elf tour to the 'North Pole': Enchanted Forest, wishing tree, Elves' Workshop, storytelling with Mrs Claus, letter writing, crafts and games, then an individual family visit with Father Christmas, photo and gift. Each child ticket includes a free same-day child ticket to the Titanic Experience. Quieter times: November and weekdays before 4 Dec. Father Christmas arrives and switches on Titanic's lights on Sun 22 Nov (details TBC). Separate quiet sessions bookable by phone.
events.venue: Titanic Belfast, 1 Olympic Way, Queens Road
events.price: Child £29 midweek / £33 weekends; adult £15; under-2s free

events.name: Inclusive All Ability Music and Sensory Session
events.description: A free, fully accessible music session for children and young people of all abilities (ages 3–18) at Carrickfergus Museum & Civic Centre: live music and sing-alongs, interactive rhythm and percussion games and accessible drumming that everyone can join in with, finishing with a sensory disco. Booking required via the Mid & East Antrim tourism page (or call 028 2563 5077).
events.venue: Carrickfergus Museum & Civic Centre, 11 Antrim Street, BT38 7DG

events.name: Paw Patrol movie day (Cinemagic Movies at the Museum), Ulster Museum
events.description: Cinemagic's Movies at the Museum: three Paw Patrol films screened in the Ulster Museum on one Sunday: Paw Patrol: The Movie (10:30am), The Mighty Movie (1pm) and The Dino Movie (3pm). Book each screening separately; under-2s free unless they need a seat.
events.venue: Ulster Museum, Stranmillis Road, Botanic Gardens, BT9 5AB

events.name: Christmas Movies at the Museum (Cinemagic), Ulster Museum
events.description: Cinemagic Christmas screenings in the Ulster Museum: Stick Man, The Muppet Christmas Carol and The Grinch on Sat 12 Dec, and Mog's Christmas and The Snowman on Sun 13 Dec (U-rated shorts and family films). Book each screening separately.
events.time: Sat from 10:15, Sun from 10:15 (see booking page)
events.venue: Ulster Museum, Stranmillis Road, Botanic Gardens, BT9 5AB

events.name: Storytelling & Crafts with Goldilocks & the Three Bears, The MAC
events.description: Drama and storytelling workshop with storytellers Jason and Gen: help Goldilocks retell the story with a new twist, then make wooden spoon puppets to take home. For ages 6–11.
events.venue: The MAC, 10 Exchange Street West, BT1 2NJ

events.name: Messy Play for SEN (Messy Martians)
events.description: SEN messy play class designed specifically for children with special educational needs (SEN classes ages 2–10; small group of up to 10). Sensory activities such as squishy paint, textured playdough and calming water play, child-led at their own pace with one-to-one support from a leader with over a decade of SEN experience. Parent attendance required; wear old clothes. Book online; sibling add-on available. A 4-class SEN package (£47.50) is also offered.
events.venue: St Mary's on the Hill Parish, 165 Antrim Road, Glengormley, Newtownabbey, BT36 7QR

events.name: Family Halloween Magic Show with Trevor Price, Saint Patrick Centre
events.description: Family Halloween magic show with magician Trevor Price: tricks, laughs and a Halloween theme for kids and adults. Booking required.
events.venue: The Saint Patrick Centre, 53A Market Street, Downpatrick, BT30 6LZ

events.name: Hedgehog Heroes: family wildlife event, Castlewellan Forest Park
events.description: Free hedgehog-themed wildlife afternoon with hands-on activities about hedgehogs and their habitats (NMD Forest Activities). No booking; look for the purple flag. Parking charges apply; weather dependent.

events.name: Hedgehog Heroes: family wildlife event, Delamont Country Park
events.description: Free hedgehog-themed wildlife event with hands-on activities about hedgehogs and their habitats (NMD Forest Activities). No booking; look for the purple flag. Parking charges apply; weather dependent.

events.name: Santa in Oz, Saint Patrick Centre
events.description: Christmas experience: follow the yellow brick road through a winter wonderland of Oz, meet the Scarecrow, Tin Man and Dorothy, then visit Santa in his Emerald City workshop. Timed slots; book online or call 028 4461 9000.
events.venue: The Saint Patrick Centre, Market Street, Downpatrick, BT30 6LZ
events.price: See booking page (2024 price was £15 per child, £45 family)

events.name: Sensory Christmas Nativity Trail, Maze Presbyterian Church
events.description: Free evening event for families with children who have additional needs: restricted numbers and visual schedules, a walk-through nativity trail, interactive nativity scene, sensory play, a quiet dark den, bouncy castles, crafts and biscuits/sweets. Pre-registration required; pick an arrival slot (6:00, 6:15, 6:30 or 6:45pm) on the church's registration form.
events.venue: Maze Presbyterian Church, Kesh Road, Mazetown, Lisburn BT27 5RP
